\newcommand{\tableBasketBenchmark}{%

\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\caption{2D basket call-on-minimum DPG prices vs exact-terminal Monte Carlo,
  $N=64$, $N_t=500$, $K=100$, $T=1$, $r=0.05$, $\sigma_1=\sigma_2=0.20$.
  MC: $n=10^7$, seed=42, exact log-normal terminal sampling.
  $\lambda_{\min}(A)=\tfrac{1}{2}(1-|\rho|)\sigma^2$.}

\small
\begin{tabular}{rrrrrrr}
\toprule
$\rho$ & $\lambda_{\min}(A)$ & DPG price & MC price & 95\% CI & rel.\ err.\ (\%) & in CI \\
\midrule
$-0.80$ & 0.0040 & 1.2411 & 0.8078 & [0.8063,\ 0.8093] & 53.6 & $\times$ \\
$-0.50$ & 0.0100 & 2.0774 & 1.6814 & [1.6788,\ 1.6840] & 23.6 & $\times$ \\
$-0.20$ & 0.0160 & 2.9892 & 2.6137 & [2.6100,\ 2.6173] & 14.4 & $\times$ \\
$+0.00$ & 0.0200 & 3.6510 & 3.2953 & [3.2909,\ 3.2996] & 10.8 & $\times$ \\
$+0.20$ & 0.0160 & 4.3662 & 4.0460 & [4.0410,\ 4.0511] &  7.9 & $\times$ \\
$+0.50$ & 0.0100 & 5.5643 & 5.3805 & [5.3744,\ 5.3866] &  3.4 & $\times$ \\
$+0.75$ & 0.0050 & 6.7089 & 6.8597 & [6.8525,\ 6.8668] &  2.2 & $\times$ \\
$+0.90$ & 0.0020 & 7.4756 & 8.1759 & [8.1680,\ 8.1839] &  8.6 & $\times$ \\
$+0.95$ & 0.0010 & 7.7465 & 8.8405 & [8.8322,\ 8.8488] & 12.4 & $\times$ \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\footnotesize\textit{None of the 9 tested cases fall inside the MC 95\% CI at $N=64$.
Accuracy improves with $|\rho|$ decreasing toward 0.75 (min 2.2\%)
and degrades near $\rho=\pm1$ where the operator is near-degenerate.}
\end{table}
}
